status: DRAFT tip text for rubric v0.3 (docs/phase1/rubric_v0_3.json), 15 Nov 2026, for Cam to edit. One sentence per fault, in our own words, from Cam's points, Toby Radford, the governing-body manuals and the research summarised in docs/phase1/coaching_sources.md. No wording is copied from a source.
order: faults_in_chain_order of rubric v0.3, then F00

tips.F01: Keep your head still and your eyes level as the bowler runs in, so you get the clearest view of the ball.
tips.F02: Stand with your weight even and your knees soft, so you can move forward or back with equal ease.
tips.F17: As the bowler lets go, have your head over off stump or between middle and off, so your eyes are in line with the ball.
tips.F13: Start lifting the bat a little earlier, as the bowler gets ready to let go, so the swing has time to flow.
tips.F03: Lift your hands up and back, close to your body, with your top hand in charge; it does not matter if the bat points towards the slips.
tips.F19: Drive only when the ball is pitched up; if it is short, go back or leave it.
tips.F15: Move forward towards the ball rather than across the crease, so your head stays in line and you can hit straight.
tips.F04: Let your head and front shoulder lead you towards the ball, and your front foot will follow.
tips.F05: Step towards the ball and land your front foot on its line, or just inside it, so the bat has room to come through.
tips.F06: Bend your front knee as you land so that it takes your weight, instead of leaving the weight on your back foot.
tips.F18: Push off your back foot as you step forward, so your weight drives into the shot.
tips.F16: Get your weight moving towards the ball, so your head and chest are over your front foot when you hit it.
tips.F07: Keep your front shoulder pointing down the line of the shot until you have hit the ball, because an early open shoulder pulls the bat across.
tips.F08: Bring the bat down straight along the line of the ball, and if it keeps coming across, check your stance first: head over your toes and eyes in line with off stump.
tips.F09: Make it one smooth movement from backlift to contact; a short settle of the front foot is fine, but do not stop and start.
tips.F10: Keep your head over the ball and meet it close to your front pad, so you stay in control and keep it on the ground.
tips.F11: Hold your finish for a count of two, and if you cannot, keep your head over your front knee next time.
tips.F12: Let your hands keep going towards your target after you hit the ball, and finish with the bat under control.
tips.F00: Nothing major to fix: this is a good, balanced drive, so keep repeating it.

retired.F14: Now part of F07 (the top half closes and the front shoulder stays aligned to the shot).
